definitions: A piece of clothing, typically made of wool or cotton, that covers the top part of the body and is pulled on over the head.
A person or animal that jumps.
A short connecting wire with clips at each end, used for making temporary connections in electronic circuits.
A pinafore dress, typically worn over a blouse or sweater.
examples: She wore a warm woollen jumper.
The horse is an excellent jumper.
He used a jumper to bypass the circuit.
The girl wore a jumper over her shirt.
